primitive.relation: one contract, by conversion: Extremal.XE1.xe1_tree and Packing.XE1.xe1_tree (is_forest [set: T] /\ connected [set: T]) are definitionally the upstream GraphTheory.core.sgraph.is_tree [set: T], the whole-carrier tree (unique irredundant paths and connectivity over every vertex); no second predicate and no nonempty guard are introduced, so 'K_0 stays a tree. GTBase.trees is a focused support layer over the upstream canonical: the Boolean is_treeb with is_treeP, the whole-carrier projections/introduction, and groundings ('K_0, 'K_1, 'K_2 and the claw 'K_1,3 are trees; 'K_3 and two isolated vertices are not). A tree on an arbitrary supplied vertex set is upstream's broader API; both migrated wrappers select the whole carrier. Distinct, untouched: B18's labelled fg_spanning_tree (a valid edge subset of a host), B19's multigraph edge-carrier spanning_tree_edge_set, D2tur.tree_on / shortest_tree_on, U9.tree_contains_T, the directed trees of X2 and P9, and B9's degree-bounded path_tree.

whole-graph-tree.note: is_forest [set: T] /\ connected [set: T]: the body of upstream is_tree [set: T], convertible. Seven complete rows are frozen over the frozen wrapper (Extremal XE1 #548/#550/#557/#568, XE2 #547/#549, Packing XE1 #743) with every guard, quantifier order, Ramsey leastness, dependent embedding and natural subtraction exact, plus five complete combined Originals (#548 with A7 and A5, #550 and #547 with A6, #568 with A6/A7/A11, #549 with C7 and A6) over the earlier families' frozen bodies; the 22 earlier snapshots that still call the live wrapper stay byte-exact with reciprocal notes. #548's prose claim that k >= 1 follows from its guards is false (k = 0 is admitted) and is recorded without repair.

upstream_audit.note: coq-graph-theory's sgraph.v defines is_forest, is_tree S := is_forest S /\ connected S, is_forestb, connectedb and the reflections is_forestP / connectedP, with forestI, treeI, forest3, unique_forestT and the complete graphs; both migrated wrappers are is_tree at the whole carrier verbatim, so the canonical is upstream and GTBase.trees only adds the whole-carrier support API and groundings (reusing B9's path-tree proofs for 'K_0, 'K_1, 'K_2 and proving the claw directly from splitL / irred_edgeL / irredxx). GTBase.trees is not re-exported by GTBase.base.
